source_anchors.operation: MzTabMMetaData's constructor sets mz_tab_version to "2.0.0-M"; MzTabMMetaData::default() does the same
addMetaInfoToOptionalColumns substitutes '_' for ' ' in the column NAME only and looks the key up unchanged; the body is byte-identical to MzTab::addMetaInfoToOptionalColumns at MzTab.cpp:590-609

getFeatureMapMetaValues_ substitutes '_' for ' ' in every collected feature key BEFORE storing it, so the later metaValueExists() lookup misses any key with a space; MzTabMExportOptions::substitute_keys_before_lookup
the same substitution for observation-match keys
observation-match keys containing "IDConverter_trace" are excluded, because IdentificationDataConverter adds one per traced record
the same substitution for identified-compound keys
OPENMS_PRECONDITION(!id_data.empty()) is debug-only; a release build reads an empty graph. The port returns Error::MissingInformation
mz_tab_id is "local_id: " plus FeatureMap::getUniqueId(), a UInt64
the vocabulary is loaded from File::find("/CV/psi-ms.obo") under the name "PSI-MS"; this port takes a &ControlledVocabulary instead
"TOPP " + software name is looked up first, and "analysis software" is the fallback; MS:1001456 appears three times and MS:1002169 once in the retained output
software[n] indices are assigned as map.size() + 1, so they follow the (name, version) order of std::set<ProcessingSoftware>
quantification_method is LC-MS label-free quantitation analysis for FeatureFinderMetabo, and the fallback at line 246 uses the same term, so the output cannot differ
the input-file loop overwrites ms_run[1]-location, so the last input file in set order wins; the comment says there should only be one
the location has every backslash replaced by a slash and is file://-prefixed unless already prefixed

scan polarity is positive only when first_adduct.at(first_adduct.size() - 1) == '+', so every other final character - including the 'H' of a name such as M+H - selects negative; an empty name underflows and at() throws std::out_of_range. The port matches on the last character, reproducing the == '+' test for every non-empty name and selecting positive for the empty one instead of throwing
with no adduct at all the source warns and assumes positive scan polarity
assay[1] is "assay_" plus the trimmed prefix of the basename up to the first '.'; String::prefix(char) throws when the basename has no '.', where the port uses the whole basename
meta_cv.label = cv.name() and meta_cv.full_name = cv.label() cross the two; both retained fixtures show cv[1]-label PSI-MS and cv[1]-full_name MS. MzTabMExportOptions::swap_cv_label_and_full_name

the MzTabMDatabaseMetaData record is declared outside the loop and accumulates, so a search parameter without a database_location keeps the previous parameter's URI instead of the https://hmdb.ca/ default set at line 364
a database name containing "custom" nulls the prefix and writes "[,, <name>, ]"; otherwise the prefix is the database name and the parameter is "[,,<name>, ]"

the quantification unit is guessed from FeatureFinderMetabo's "parameter: algorithm:mtd:quant_method": area -> MS1 feature area, median -> median, anything else -> MS1 feature maximum intensity; absent -> MS1 feature area at line 430
small_molecule-identification_reliability is always "compound identification confidence level" (MS:1002896)
id_confidence_measure[n] is "[,, <score type name>, ]", one per assigned score of each software in the IDENTIFICATION action list, numbered from 1 in software order

identification_method and ms_level per tool: AccurateMassSearch -> accurate mass at level 1, SiriusAdapter -> de novo search at level 2, MetaboliteSpectralMatcher -> TOPP SpecLibSearcher at level 2, anything else level 1
ms_level defaults to level 1 when no identification tool ran
the placeholder "[, , OpenMS TOPP, ]" is detected by its empty CV label and accession and replaced with "data processing action" (MS:1000543); that is what the retained store output's SME rows carry
a feature with no identification still gets an SMF row, with a null SME_ID_REFS, a null ambiguity code, and its adduct from the feature's own "adducts" meta value or null

std::set<ObservationMatchRef, CompareMzTabMMatchRef> discards every match that shares an identified compound's identifier with an earlier one, and the survivor depends on the address ordering of the feature's own reference set. MzTabMExportOptions::deduplicate_matches_by_compound
evidence_input_id is "mass=<mz>,rt=<rt>" with StringUtils::toStr(double), i.e. fifteen fractional digits trimmed
calc_mass_to_charge is the compound formula's monoisotopic mass, uncorrected for adduct and charge, so the theoretical_mass_to_charge column holds a neutral mass
ScoredProcessingResult::getScore returns (NaN, false) for an absent score and the NaN is stored in a value cell, which renders NaN rather than the NaN state
SME_ID_REF_ambiguity_code is null for at most one referenced evidence and 1 otherwise
one SML row per SMF row: OpenMS does not aggregate two features whose adducts imply the same neutral mass
the std::find_if iterator that locates the referenced SME row is dereferenced without comparing it to end(); the port returns Error::MissingInformation
theoretical_neutral_mass is EmpiricalFormula(chemical_formula).getMonoWeight() unless the cell renders "" or "null"; the "" test is dead because MzTabString renders a null cell as "null"
abundance_study_variable[1] and abundance_variation_study_variable[1] are created by operator[] and then set null, which is why the retained SML rows carry those two columns
getAdductString_ reformats M+H;1+ to [M+H]1+ by splitting on the first ';' only, and returns the literal "null" when the match has no adduct
mzTab-version and mzTab-ID are written unconditionally, so an unset cell appears as null; title and description are guarded
the ms_run block writes location, instrument_ref, format, fragmentation_method[m], scan_polarity[m], hash and hash_method, and never id_format. MzTabMWriteOptions::omit_ms_run_id_format
an assay's custom[m] is written under the key ms_run[<assay index>]-custom[m]. MzTabMWriteOptions::source_assay_custom_key
assay[n]-sample_ref is guarded by isNull() while assay[n]-ms_run_ref at line 246 is not, so a null ms_run_ref writes ms_run[null]
study_variable[n]-assay_refs is a String[] cell of assay[k] tokens, pipe-separated
derivatization_agent[n] is written with a -uri suffix the specification does not define. MzTabMWriteOptions::source_derivatization_agent_key
colunit_small_molecule_feature is written under the key colunit_small_molecule. MzTabMWriteOptions::source_colunit_keys
colunit_small_molecule_evidence is written under the key colunit_small_molecule as well
the SML header spells the adduct column adduct_ions, while the SFH and SEH headers spell it adduct_ion
the SMH abundance columns come from meta.assay once and from meta.study_variable twice; the SFH header at line 457 takes only meta.assay
the SML row's abundance cells are emitted by iterating the row's own maps, not the metadata's, so a short row is possible. MzTabMWriteOptions::source_row_abundance_cells
MzTabFile::addOptionalColumnsToSectionRow_ is called from all three row generators; its body is at MzTabFile.cpp:2873-2892 and is reproduced here as write::optional_cells
the SEH column for calc_mass_to_charge is named theoretical_mass_to_charge, and the id_confidence_measure[n] columns at line 513 sit between ms_level and rank
store accepts only the mzTab and tsv file types, with FileHandler::hasValidExtension also permitting an unknown extension; the failure is Exception::UnableToCreateFile, mapped to Error::InvalidValue
one empty line precedes each of the three headers, and there is no trailing empty line
the three column-count checks are OPENMS_POSTCONDITIONs, compiled out of a release build; the port's native options make a mismatch impossible instead
the lines are written through TextFile, so every line including the last gets one terminator

every rendered row reaches TextFile unchanged, so a cell carrying a tab gains a column and one carrying a line break splits the row across physical lines - text beginning with MTD/SMH/SML then forges a line of that kind; the OPENMS_POSTCONDITION column check cannot see it because it counts pushed cells rather than tabs. MzTabMWriteOptions::source_verbatim_cells, default off

evidence: Tier 1 for the writer's line grammar and for the exporter's metadata section; tier 3 for the data model; tier 4 for the ceilings, the native error paths and the non-ASCII inputs. Two unmodified retained C++ outputs are committed and hashed above: MzTabMFile_output_1.mztab, the exact bytes MzTabMFile_test.cpp's store section compares against, and AccurateMassSearchEngine_output1_mztabm_featureXML.mzTab, the retained MzTab-M output of the one direct TOPP consumer of MzTabMFile.h. Against those two files this package asserts byte equality for: all 25 MTD lines of the first and all 24 of the second, each reproduced twice - once from a hand-built MzTabMMetaData through generate_meta_data_section, and once from MzTabM::export_feature_map_with driven by a synthetic IdentificationData graph; all six header lines, including the two id_confidence_measure[n] columns the second fixture declares; SML row 3, SMF row 1 and SME row 1 of both files, with all 18 and all 6 optional columns of the first; the three section sizes 83/83/312 and the three optional-column counts 0/18/6 that the exportFeatureMapToMzTabM section asserts; and the three-empty-line section structure. Ten PSI-MS accessions the exporter selects (MS:1001456, MS:1002169, MS:1001834, MS:1000130, MS:1000129, MS:1001844, MS:1002896, MS:1000207, MS:1000511, MS:1000543) are confirmed both against the pinned resources/cv/psi-ms.obo and against the retained bytes. Five of the seven START_SECTIONs are ported; the exporter section has partial retained-output-count evidence and the store section is mapped to selected retained-row comparisons and none unaccounted; the 21-macro Fill data structure section is transcribed literal by literal, and transcribed C++ literals are tier-3 evidence. The one gap is that neither data-carrying section's INPUT can be fed to the port: both load MzTabMFile_input_1.oms and OMSFile.h is unported, so the exporter has no end-to-end tier-1 differential - its metadata section is verified byte for byte and its row construction only behaviourally. No C++ was built or executed for this package.
gaps: MzTabMFile_input_1.oms cannot be read: OMSFile.h is unported. Both data-carrying class-test sections load it, so the exporter's row construction is verified behaviourally rather than end to end. This is why the MzTabM.h ledger status is partial.
The MzTabM writer retains its budgeted private write::optional_cells helper; the separate, implemented mztab_file module exposes optional_column_cells for proteomics mzTab.

ControlledVocabulary::psi_ms() holds all five pinned vocabularies in one object, so its name/label/version/url identify the last one loaded and MzTabM::export_feature_map produces a generic cv[1] block. The tests load resources/cv/psi-ms.obo alone under the name PSI-MS to reproduce the source's cv[1]; a PSI-MS-only accessor on ControlledVocabulary would remove the need.
MzTab-M has no reader in this port or the pinned MzTabMFile API. Proteomics MzTabFile loading is implemented in both languages; its tests and scope are separate.
docs/core-sdk-coverage.json and docs/core-sdk-reviewed-apis.json are not updated by this package; the ledger entries and the coverage regeneration are proposed in the work-package report.
